svg.title: Isolated execution on rest2mcp's infrastructure
svg.desc: AI-generated code runs only on rest2mcp's infrastructure, inside a temporary, isolated sandbox, with time and memory limits, minimal access to registered tools, and dangerous operations blocked. At the end, everything is deleted. If it fails, a clear error goes back to the AI to fix and retry.

g.text: doesn't run on your machine or your server
If it fails, the AI gets a clear error
